summary_en: Interim dividend for fiscal year ending June 2027 raised to 15 yen per share (13 yen ordinary dividend plus 2 yen commemorative dividend). Dividend policy amended to adjust total payout ratio calculation by excluding equity method investment gains/losses and certain non-recurring items from net income attributable to parent company shareholders.
title_en: Notice of Revisions to Interim Dividend Forecast and Changes to Dividend Policy in Conjunction with Commemorative Dividend
translation_en_brief:
Hirayama Holdings announced a revision to its interim dividend forecast for fiscal year ending June 2027. The interim dividend per share has been increased from the previously forecasted 13 yen to 15 yen per share, comprising an ordinary dividend of 13 yen and a commemorative dividend of 2 yen. The company will mark its 60th anniversary in May 2027 and its rebranding to KEDiX Holdings Co., Ltd. The annual dividend forecast remains at 44 yen per share (up from the prior forecast of 42 yen), reflecting this interim adjustment.

Concurrently, the company amended its dividend policy effective from the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (retroactively from October 1, 2026). The policy modification clarifies the calculation methodology for the total payout ratio (defined as annual dividends plus next year's share repurchase amount, divided by adjusted net income). The revised approach excludes equity method investment gains/losses and certain non-recurring gains/losses from the parent company's net income when calculating the denominator. The dividend payout ratio floor remains above 40%, and the total payout ratio target remains within 50%, both on a consolidated basis. The company stated that this adjustment reflects the non-cash nature of equity method earnings and non-recurring items, which do not result in actual cash inflows unless counterpart companies pay dividends or realize transactions.
